allow: Bash(node -e "const { DatabaseSync } = require\('node:sqlite'\); const db = new DatabaseSync\(':memory:'\); db.exec\('CREATE TABLE t \(x\)'\); const stmt = db.prepare\('INSERT INTO t VALUES \(?\)'\); stmt.run\(42\); const r = db.prepare\('SELECT * FROM t'\).all\(\); console.log\('node:sqlite ok', JSON.stringify\(r\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const d=require\('fs'\).readFileSync\('/dev/stdin','utf8'\); const r=JSON.parse\(d\); console.log\('Tracks:', r.length\); r.forEach\(t => console.log\(' ', t.track, '-', t.lap_count, 'laps, fastest:', t.fastest_ms+'ms by', t.fastest_driver\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const d=require\('fs'\).readFileSync\('/dev/stdin','utf8'\); const r=JSON.parse\(d\); console.log\('Drivers:', r.length\); r.slice\(0,5\).forEach\(d => console.log\(' ', d.driver_name, '-', d.total_laps, 'laps'\)\);" kill %1)

Bash(node -e "const r=require\('/tmp/tracks.json'\); console.log\('Count:',r.length\); r.forEach\(t=>console.log\(' ',t.track,'-',t.lap_count,'laps, fastest:',t.fastest_ms+'ms by',t.fastest_driver\)\);")

Bash(node -e "process.stdin.resume\(\); let d=''; process.stdin.on\('data',c=>d+=c\); process.stdin.on\('end',\(\)=>{ const r=JSON.parse\(d\); console.log\('Tracks:',r.length\); r.slice\(0,8\).forEach\(t=>console.log\(' ',t.track,'-',t.lap_count,'laps, best:',t.fastest_ms+'ms by',t.fastest_driver\)\); }\);")

Bash(node -e "process.stdin.resume\(\); let d=''; process.stdin.on\('data',c=>d+=c\); process.stdin.on\('end',\(\)=>{ const r=JSON.parse\(d\); console.log\('Drivers:',r.length\); r.forEach\(d=>console.log\(' ',d.driver_name,'-',d.total_laps,'total laps,',d.track_count,'tracks'\)\); }\);")

Bash(node -e "process.stdin.resume\(\); let d=''; process.stdin.on\('data',c=>d+=c\); process.stdin.on\('end',\(\)=>{ const r=JSON.parse\(d\); console.log\('\\nSessions total:',r.total\); r.sessions.forEach\(s=>console.log\(' ',s.session_type,s.track,'by',s.server_name\)\); }\);")

PowerShell($procs = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if \($procs\) { $procs | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "Killed PID $_" } } else { Write-Host "Port 3001 is free" })
